invariants.rationale: writeClient is dereferenced in the method, so it must not be null.
instantTime is passed to writeClient.bulkInsertPreppedRecords and commit, so must not be null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed as an argument to bulkInsertPreppedRecords and should not be null.
bulkInsertPartitioner is passed to a method, so its reference should not be null.
preppedRecordInputs is a list of HoodieRecord, so any contained elements should be HoodieRecord.
